After each auction, we will display all bids. Ties for the highest bid will be resolved randomly.


This is round 1 of 1.
Your private value for this item is $20.

I need to trade off win probability against profit margin - bidding full value leaves no profit. So I will shade my bid below my valuation to keep a positive surplus if I win while remaining competitive. The long-run optimal is to bid a fraction of value, proportional to valuation.
